caption: The drawing depicts a single jug or pitcher centrally placed and rendered in grayscale with pencil or graphite on a light-colored, possibly cream paper. The pitcher has a tall, cylindrical body with vertical, elongated, rounded arch-shaped panels as decorative elements along its surface. The upper rim and the base of the pitcher are bordered by a line of small, round beads. The spout, on the left side, is wide and gently curves outward with a scalloped edge that echoes the beaded border. The handle, attached to the upper and lower sections of the right side of the body, is ornate with a flowing, undulating shape and a hooked end. The drawing is surrounded by a thin, plain rectangular border that frames the jug within the overall composition. There are slight stains and spots of discoloration on the paper, but the central object remains clearly visible and precisely detailed.
title: Pewter Creamer
